_comment: Files the add-on needs, by feature. tools/check_install.ps1 renders this; the versions match the 'setup this was verified on' table in README.md. Paths are relative to the folder holding mgs4.exe. Keep this file the single place filenames, versions and download links are written down.

sections.title: Required
sections.blurb: Without these the add-on does not load or DLSS cannot be created.

files.name: The game
files.detail: Metal Gear Solid 4, Master Collection Vol. 2

files.name: ReShade, with add-on support
files.detail: installed for mgs4.exe as dxgi.dll - the add-on build, not the plain one

files.name: Add-on configuration
files.detail: shipped next to the add-on; the first run writes InternalRes into it

files.name: DLSS runtime
files.detail: from the DLSS SDK, or supplied by the NVIDIA app's DLSS override

sections.title: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering
sections.blurb: Optional. With these present the add-on runs DLAA on the final image so NR works at full strength.

files.name: Neural Rendering add-on
files.detail: auto-detected; its presence switches the insertion point to the composite

files.name: DLSS NR runtime
files.detail: from the DLSS SDK, or supplied by the NVIDIA app

sections.title: Frame generation
sections.blurb: Optional, needs FrameGen in the ini. Only helps when the display refreshes faster than the game's 60 fps.

sections.title: Extras
sections.blurb: Optional. The frame limiter, and the pieces the development tooling uses.

files.name: Ultimate ASI Loader
files.detail: loads the .asi files in scripts\ (mgs4.exe imports winmm at startup)

files.name: D3D12 switch (fallback)
files.detail: only for builds without the in-game DirectX 12 option; leave Enabled = 0 otherwise

files.name: Steam app id
files.detail: lets mgs4.exe --stage boot without going through Steam
